title: Horns of Hattin vs Cappadocian Riders
lede: Cappadocian Riders beat Horns of Hattin 32-22 on Victory Points at the end of Battle Round 5, after holding the 3 VP centre objective in each of the first four rounds. Dragoon Brethren anchored that centre and shot the Caliphate's first 5 CP Troop Requisition off the table in the round it arrived, so Horns of Hattin's maxed-out LEAD FROM THE FRONT never caught up.
result_line: Cappadocian Riders win 32-22 on Victory Points in Battle Round 5
deployment:
Two mounted armies on CROSSROADS: the 3 VP objective in the centre at (7,7), 2 VP objectives on the west (1,7) and east (13,7) flanks. Horns of Hattin (Player A, initiative, south edge) put Saladin - Al-Malik al-Nasir (Mounted) with Khassakiyya Guard 1 on the west at (4,13) beside Muqatila Troopers 2, Muqatila Troopers 1 in the middle at (7,12), and Isfahsalar with Khassakiyya Guard 2 out east at (11,13). That split the two CHARACTER squads across both flanks, which suits LEAD FROM THE FRONT (a CHARACTER in an Objective Area or the enemy half each round), but left the centre to one 13 RP infantry squad.

Cappadocian Riders (Player B, north edge) stacked the right of centre: Archistrategos (Mounted) with Crimson Knights 1 at (9,2) and Dragoon Brethren at (11,1), with Crimson Knights 2 at (5,2) and Covenant Levies with the Cantor-Preceptor at (3,2) facing the west objective. Both sides were 246 RP at deployment; Cappadocian Riders' Primary, BREAK THEIR HOLD, rewards standing in objectives the enemy holds, so the plan was to take the centre first and contest the flanks after.

1.title: The Riders take the middle unopposed

feed.text: Cappadocian Riders spent all 3 CP on Troop Requisition for a second Covenant Levies at (8,2). Horns of Hattin spent its 1 Al-Kimiya Ingredient on Matter Transmutation: Zi'baq Beads (SUSTAINED ATTACK 1) for Saladin. Both sides kept BREAK CONTACT.

Everyone advanced. Crimson Knights 1 with the Archistrategos stopped at (8,7) and Dragoon Brethren at (8,6), both in the centre's Objective Area; Muqatila Troopers 1 reached (6,7) on the other side of it. On the west, Covenant Levies and the Cantor-Preceptor reached (1,6) against Muqatila Troopers 2 at (2,8).
Nobody had a target: every unit on both sides was idle with no legal action.
Cappadocian Riders' OC won both contested objectives: centre 3 VP and west 2 VP, 5-0. LEAD FROM THE FRONT scored nothing: neither Saladin nor Isfahsalar ended in an Objective Area or the enemy half.

2.title: Two Muqatila squads gone, one of them bought this round

feed.text: Horns of Hattin paid 5 CP for Troop Requisition: a third Muqatila Troopers at (6,12). Cappadocian Riders paid 3 CP for Secure Objective on Covenant Levies (OC +1), which decided nothing. Horns of Hattin kept MAN OF THE HOUR, Cappadocian Riders COORDINATED PUSH.

Crimson Knights 2 charged Muqatila Troopers 2 at (1,8) and Crimson Knights 1 with the Archistrategos charged Muqatila Troopers 1 from (7,8); Dauntless Assault put HIT -1 on both targets. Khassakiyya Guard 2 and Isfahsalar charged the second Covenant Levies at (6,6), but the Levies broke away in disorder (3 HP) to (8,5). Muqatila Troopers 2 also fell back in disorder (3 HP) to (4,9). Both Fall Backs completed BREAK CONTACT at Cleanup, 2 VP each.

Dragoon Brethren used Successive Discharge (+1 FR) and put 20 damage into the newly requisitioned Muqatila Troopers: the 5 CP unit was destroyed in the round it arrived. The Archistrategos used Quis ut Deus? (+2 FR, AR and DMG, LETHAL) and struck Muqatila Troopers 1 for 10, taking 2 back on Crimson Knights 1, and Crimson Knights 1 finished the squad with another 10. Saladin shot Crimson Knights 2 for 4 and Khassakiyya Guard 1 shot Covenant Levies for 4. The Cantor-Preceptor cast Agnus Dei (6 Mana) on Covenant Levies.
Cappadocian Riders scored 7 (centre 3, west 2, BREAK CONTACT 2) for 12; Horns of Hattin 4 (LEAD FROM THE FRONT 2 for Isfahsalar's squad forward at (6,6), BREAK CONTACT 2). 4-12.

3.title: Saladin takes the west, the centre stays blue

feed.text: Benediction healed Crimson Knights 2 for 4. Cappadocian Riders' Scouting Order (1 CP) on Crimson Knights 2, standing in the enemy half, completed COMMAND AUTHORITY on the spot for 2 VP. Horns of Hattin put Double Time (2 CP) on Muqatila Troopers 2 and kept FOCUSED FIRE.

Saladin and Khassakiyya Guard 1 charged into Crimson Knights 2, Covenant Levies and the Cantor-Preceptor at (1,7). Crimson Knights 2 failed its Fall Back test and broke away in disorder (2 HP) to (2,9). In the centre Crimson Knights 1 charged Khassakiyya Guard 2 and Isfahsalar; Khassakiyya Guard 2 passed its test and fell back clean to (5,4), leaving the centre to Cappadocian Riders again. Dragoon Brethren stepped to (7,8).

Khassakiyya Guard 1's Rumh Lances took Covenant Levies from 15 HP down through its Levy Elder, but Agnus Dei's Response put the squad back as it stood before the attack. Saladin's Zulfiqar of Ali then landed 7 hits for 13 damage (15 to 2). Dragoon Brethren, again with Successive Discharge, shot Muqatila Troopers 2 for 11.

Horns of Hattin took the west objective (2 VP) and scored 3 on LEAD FROM THE FRONT, 5 in all for 9. Cappadocian Riders scored 6: centre 3, COMMAND AUTHORITY 2 and BREAK THEIR HOLD 1 for Covenant Levies inside the west objective Horns of Hattin now held. 9-18.

4.title: Another requisition, another dead Muqatila squad

feed.text: Horns of Hattin spent another 5 CP on Troop Requisition (Muqatila Troopers #2 at (7,12)). Cappadocian Riders requisitioned a third Covenant Levies at (8,2) for 3 CP and gave Covenant Levies #2 Double Time for 2 CP. Horns of Hattin kept DEEP REACH, Cappadocian Riders SECURE THE FLANKS.

Covenant Levies #2 ran from (8,7) to (3,8) on Double Time. Crimson Knights 2 charged Saladin at (2,7) and Crimson Knights 1 with the Archistrategos left the centre to charge Muqatila Troopers #2 at (6,9). Khassakiyya Guard 2 came back to (5,7). Dauntless Assault put HIT -1 on Saladin and Khassakiyya Guard 1, and the record prices that at 1.36 expected HP kept off Cappadocian Riders.

Saladin's attack on Crimson Knights 2 did nothing and the counterattack took 6 off Khassakiyya Guard 1. Crimson Knights 1 hit Muqatila Troopers #2 for 10 and the Archistrategos for 4 more. Khassakiyya Guard 1 then struck the Cantor-Preceptor's pair and destroyed Covenant Levies (2 HP left), the only enemy unit Horns of Hattin destroyed all battle.

Dragoon Brethren held the centre alone (3 VP, hinged on it). Horns of Hattin kept the west (2), scored LEAD FROM THE FRONT 2 and DEEP REACH 3, 7 for 16; Cappadocian Riders 4 (centre 3, BREAK THEIR HOLD 1) for 22. FOCUSED FIRE expired unplayed.

5.title: Khassakiyya Guard 1 falls and the west flips

feed.text: With Cappadocian Riders at 22, this round could end it. Horns of Hattin spent 3 CP on Secure Objective for Khassakiyya Guard 1 and 3 Al-Kimiya Ingredients on Iksir Dust for Isfahsalar; neither bought anything. Cappadocian Riders kept IRON GRIP and held its 5 CP.

Khassakiyya Guard 2 and Isfahsalar charged Dragoon Brethren at (6,7), but Dragoon Brethren broke away in disorder (3 HP, one model) to (8,8) and the charge found nobody to fight. Covenant Levies #2 charged Saladin's pair at (2,8) with Dauntless Assault's HIT -1. Covenant Levies #3 walked onto the east objective at (12,6).

Saladin (5) and Khassakiyya Guard 1 (4) hacked at Covenant Levies #2. The Cantor-Preceptor cast Agnus Dei (6 Mana) on Crimson Knights 2, and Crimson Knights 2 then destroyed Khassakiyya Guard 1 (5 HP left). Muqatila Troopers #2 attacked Crimson Knights 1 with 6 HP and died to the counterattack.

Horns of Hattin took the centre with Khassakiyya Guard 2 (3 VP) and maxed LEAD FROM THE FRONT at 10/10 with 3 more, 6 for 22. Cappadocian Riders took the west and the east (4), BREAK THEIR HOLD's 3 for the flipped west, IRON GRIP 2 and SECURE THE FLANKS 1 (its second VP withheld by the 10 VP round cap): 10 for 32, past the 30 VP target.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Cappadocian Riders' 32: objectives 20 (the 3 VP centre in each of Rounds 1 to 4 is 12 of them), BREAK THEIR HOLD 5, secondaries 7 (BREAK CONTACT 2, COMMAND AUTHORITY 2, IRON GRIP 2, SECURE THE FLANKS 1). Horns of Hattin's 22: LEAD FROM THE FRONT 10, the card's full allowance, objectives 7 (west in Rounds 3 and 4, centre in Round 5) and secondaries 5 (BREAK CONTACT 2, DEEP REACH 3). The Primary did its job for the Caliphate; the objective table did not. Horns of Hattin scored nothing from objectives in the first two rounds while Cappadocian Riders took 10.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

Dragoon Brethren (45 RP) was the battle's best unit: 31 damage, the most on the field, 6.7 VP with 9 objective VP that hinged on it, and the centre held alone in Round 4. Its Successive Discharge volleys deleted the requisitioned Muqatila Troopers (20 HP) in Round 2 and took 11 off Muqatila Troopers 2 in Round 3. Crimson Knights 2 scored the most VP (6.8) and killed Khassakiyya Guard 1 in the deciding round with Agnus Dei's +1 DMG on it. The Archistrategos (Mounted) and Crimson Knights 1 did 20 damage each and destroyed Muqatila Troopers 1 in Round 2. The two requisitioned Covenant Levies (6 CP) scored 4.8 and 3.2 VP.

For Horns of Hattin, Saladin - Al-Malik al-Nasir (Mounted) did 22 damage and scored 5.8 VP, but the army destroyed one enemy unit all battle, Covenant Levies (10 RP), against four of its own (84 RP). The 10 CP it spent on two Muqatila Troopers requisitions bought units that dealt nothing and scored nothing: the first died to one volley in the round it arrived, the second was caught by Crimson Knights 1 and the Archistrategos in the round it arrived and died in the next.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The army or the AI?

Isfahsalar (55 RP) spent no APt in any of the five rounds (inaction 5); its best action each time was Kus Kettledrums at 0.3, below the AI's 0.5 threshold. Its squad's two charges both hit air, because Covenant Levies #2 (Round 2) and Dragoon Brethren (Round 5) broke away before the fight, and in Round 3 Khassakiyya Guard 2 chose to fall back from Crimson Knights 1 (the Fall Back record calls it doubtful: 10.87 expected damage against 25 HP). That pair dealt 2 damage all battle. Some of this is the alternating Movement Phase, but the Round 3 Fall Back handed back the centre. The Round 5 Secure Objective on Khassakiyya Guard 1 (3 CP) changed nothing, and the squad died that round.

The army's problem was mass in the middle. Two elite cavalry squads plus Muqatila cannot hold (7,7) against Crimson Knights, Dragoon Brethren and a stream of Levies, and the Caliphate's Muqatila Troopers (10 models, 20 HP) went straight down to Dragoon Brethren's Grenade Guns, whose SWEEP adds FR against big squads. Cappadocian Riders' Levies requisitions cost 3 CP each, against the Caliphate's 5 for Muqatila Troopers, so the cheaper side had more bodies and more CP left over.

{{chart:attrition}}

Against the first playing

The first playing went Cappadocian Riders' way too, 33-11, and ended in Round 4. This time Horns of Hattin doubled its score to 22 and lasted a round longer. The presets changed: Horns of Hattin fielded a second Muqatila Troopers, with Saladin at 75 RP (was 85) and Isfahsalar at 55 (was 60), and Cappadocian Riders swapped Akritic Outriders for a Cantor-Preceptor, whose two Agnus Dei casts restored Covenant Levies once and armed Crimson Knights 2 for the kill on Khassakiyya Guard 1. The new counting rule shows in LEAD FROM THE FRONT: in the first playing Round 2 counted 4 and scored 3, here a CHARACTER and its squad count as one, so Round 2 counted 1 and scored 2. The round cap withheld 1 VP of SECURE THE FLANKS in Round 5; in the first playing Cappadocian Riders scored 12 in Round 4 alone. Dragoon Brethren shot a freshly requisitioned Muqatila Troopers to pieces in both playings.

closing: Horns of Hattin did what its Primary asked and kept a CHARACTER forward every round from Round 2, but it never held the centre until the round it lost. Cappadocian Riders held (7,7) for four rounds with Dragoon Brethren, used Levies to soak and score, and won the swing round in the west. The Caliphate's Troop Requisitions and its idle Isfahsalar are the two things to fix before it plays this matchup again.
